# Cash4ProbateHomes

> Cash4ProbateHomes provides fast inheritance cash advances for named heirs and beneficiaries in California probate cases. We help you access your inheritance when you need it most, without waiting for probate to close.

Funds can be available in as little as 24 hours after approval. This is not a loan. There is no credit check, no repayment, and no hidden fees.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://cash4probatehomes.com/): Inheritance cash advances for California heirs, with a free application and funds in as little as 24 hours after approval.
- [How It Works](https://cash4probatehomes.com/how-it-works.html): The three-step process: apply online, case review, and receive your cash advance.
- [Apply](https://cash4probatehomes.com/#apply): Free 60-second inheritance advance application. No credit check and no obligation.
- [FAQ](https://cash4probatehomes.com/faq.html): Answers about eligibility, timing, amounts, and how probate cash advances work.
- [About](https://cash4probatehomes.com/about.html): Who Cash4ProbateHomes serves and how to contact the team at (442) 214-9444 or info@cash4probatehomes.com.
- [California locations](https://cash4probatehomes.com/california/): Inheritance advances by California county.

- [How Long Does Probate Take in California?](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/how-long-does-probate-take-in-california.html): The typical 9 to 18 month California probate timeline and why heirs wait so long.
- [Do You Have to Pay Back an Inheritance Advance?](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/do-you-pay-back-an-inheritance-advance.html): How an advance is settled from the estate, with no monthly payments and no personal liability.
- [When Heirs Disagree About Selling Inherited Property](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/heirs-disagree-selling-inherited-property.html): How probate handles heir disputes and how one heir can access their share without a forced sale.

- [How to Get Money From an Estate Before Probate Closes](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/how-to-get-money-before-probate-closes.html): Inheritance advances, probate loans, family allowances, and selling inherited property, compared.
- [Inheritance Advance vs. Probate Loan](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/inheritance-advance-vs-probate-loan.html): The difference between an advance and a loan, including credit, risk, and cost.
- [Sell an Inherited House in California](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/sell-inherited-house-california.html): How California probate sales work and when an advance is a better fit than forcing a sale.
- [What Is Heir Property?](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/what-is-heir-property.html): Why shared or unclear inherited title gets stuck, and how heirs can still access cash.
- [Inherited House Taxes: What Heirs Usually Pay](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/inherited-house-taxes.html): Income tax, stepped-up basis, California property taxes, and covering costs during probate.
- [Probate Advance in California: Costs, Timing, and Eligibility](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/probate-advance-california.html): What a California probate cash advance costs, how long it takes, and who qualifies.
- [Inheritance Advance Companies: How to Compare Offers](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/compare-inheritance-advance-companies.html): How to compare cost, fees, non-recourse terms, and California Probate Code protections.
- [Inherited House With a Mortgage: What Heirs Must Do](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/inherited-house-with-mortgage.html): Who pays the mortgage on an inherited California home and how to keep payments current during probate.
- [Probate Loans in California: How They Work and Who Qualifies](https://cash4probatehomes.com/blog/probate-loans-california.html): What a probate loan is, who qualifies, and how an inheritance advance differs from borrowing against the estate.
